en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a calm pond or small lake bordered by dense coniferous forest. A tiny hut-like structure stands on the far shore and a small group of people is visible near the water's edge. The sky is blank and pale, typical of early photographic prints. Printed red text at the top reads "Zeichenteich b. Freiberg i. S." and at the bottom "9676 Brück & Sohn, Meißen."
